description: The sellable thing -- name, identifying codes, images, lifecycle status. Deliberately excludes price: Stripe and schema.org both split Product from Price/Offer because one product sells at many prices (currency, region, subscription interval, promotional). See commerce.price for the priced-offer side. Has no id property -- consumers key products in their own catalog and reference them via productId fields on the referrer (commerce.price, commerce.line-item); this schema describes the document, not its storage key.

$kind.description: Optional self-identifier (cf. GraphQL __typename). Omit when the enclosing schema already names the role -- a value held under a property literally named product is unambiguously a product without needing $kind. Include only when this object might appear untyped outside its normal context.

description.description: Longer free-text description of the product for display, e.g. on a product detail page.

externalReferences.description: Links to corresponding records in foreign systems, e.g. Stripe or Shopify -- see external-reference for shape and validation. Replaces ad-hoc *Id fields scattered across schemas with one uniform array.

gtin.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number -- 8 digits (GTIN-8), or 12-14 digits (UPC-A/GTIN-12, EAN-13/GTIN-13, GTIN-14 for case/pallet packaging). 9, 10, or 11 digit values are not a GTIN of any kind (a 10-digit value is more likely an ISBN-10) and are rejected. Digit-length only; check-digit validation is deferred to consumers using a GS1 library.

images.description: Product photos, in display order. The first entry is conventionally the primary/cover image.

alt.description: Accessible alt text describing the image.

metadata.description: Freeform escape hatch for consumer-specific data this schema doesn't model. Deliberately non-interoperable -- a private extension zone, not part of the typed interop surface. Recommend reverse-DNS-style keys (e.g. "com.example.internalId") when multiple parties write to it.

name.description: The product's display name, e.g. "Wireless Mouse". maxLength 250 -- marketplace titles run long (Amazon caps at 200); this schema allows headroom above that rather than truncating real listings.

sku.description: Merchant-assigned stock-keeping unit code, opaque to this schema. Distinct from gtin (an industry-standard identifier) -- sku is whatever the merchant's own inventory system uses.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the catalog entry. Absent means active. archived hides the product from new sales without invalidating historical references to it -- line items and orders keep their own snapshot of name/price regardless.

title: Product
